Who We Are

A Family Rooted
in the Word

Cornerstone Community Church is a born again, Spirit-filled congregation in the heart of Entebbe, Uganda. For fifteen years we have been a community that believes in the transforming power of Jesus Christ — a place where lives are changed, families are restored, and the Kingdom of God advances.

We are a multigenerational church with vibrant ministries for every season of life — from Sunday School and youth to women's fellowship, prayer, and worship. Whatever your story, there is a place for you here.

We warmly invite you to join us — whether in one of our Sunday services, a midweek program, or during this special month of fasting and intercession.
